_s215_saveddata_basis: Family C (s215): 1.21.4's SavedData / DimensionDataStorage API on 1.21.5's SavedDataType storage (javap -c -p 1.21.4 / 1.21.5 class_18, class_26, class_10741). A converted mod's SavedData subclass extends the layer's facade SavedData (an abstract 1.21.5 SavedData keeping 1.21.4's save contract); storage calls go through rt/CbSavedData (one SavedDataType per storage and file name, codec = the factory's deserializer / the data's save, as 1.21.4's storage read and wrote the file's "data" compound); vanilla factory() methods answer a Factory standing for vanilla's 1.21.5 type of the file name.
_s215_saveddata_redirects_basis: DimensionDataStorage.computeIfAbsent / get / set (1.21.4 keyed by file name) -> 1.21.5's computeIfAbsent / get / set of the file's SavedDataType, called on the storage itself (a native mixin on 1.21.5's methods still sees the call). The vanilla factory() methods (ServerScoreboard.dataFactory, RandomSequences / Raids / StructureFeatureIndexSavedData / MapIndex / MapItemSavedData.factory) answer a Factory the storage calls resolve to vanilla's 1.21.5 type of the file name: ServerScoreboard.TYPE, RandomSequences.TYPE, Raids.TYPE / TYPE_END by id, StructureFeatureIndexSavedData.type(name), MapIndex.TYPE, MapItemSavedData.type(MapId of map_<n>).
_s215_saveddata_save_basis: SavedData.save(tag, registries) / save(registries) called through 1.21.5's SavedData (which has neither): a converted mod's data runs its own (facade SavedData); vanilla's data is written by its 1.21.5 type's codec, as 1.21.5's storage writes it under "data" (rt/CbSavedData.method_75).

net/minecraft/class_26.<init>(Ljava/nio/.basis: DimensionDataStorage(path, fixer, registries) gained the SavedData.Context its types read (a level and a world seed); a storage a mod builds itself has no level: a Context without one (seed 0). A converted mod's data reads the storage's own registries (as 1.21.4's did), so only vanilla types that read the level refuse in such a storage
